route.title: Dated word event and the people's delay claim
route.deciding_marker_or_seam: Hag.1.1 has the date, word-event formula היה דבר־יהוה ביד־חגי, named addressees, and לאמר; 1:2 supplies the introduced כה אמר declaration and quoted claim, followed by a WLC-family pe.
route.boundary_rationale: The grammatical introduction and its quoted message form one complete opening word event. The paragraph closure after 1:2 and renewed word-event formula at 1:3 provide the next seam.
route.counterevidence: The date and office-bearing names frame more than the two verses, and the house accusation continues thematically in 1:3-11.

route.title: Paneled-house accusation and the first consider-your-ways register
route.deciding_marker_or_seam: The renewed ויהי דבר־יהוה formula at 1:3 introduces the העת accusation, the שימו לבבכם על־דרכיכם summons at 1:5, and the coordinated scarcity catalogue through 1:6; a pe follows 1:6.
route.boundary_rationale: The word-event introduction, accusatory contrast, evaluative summons, and sixfold futility register constitute one accusation-and-result movement before the repeated divine-speech and consider formula at 1:7.
route.counterevidence: The repeated consider formula at 1:7 can make 1:3-11 sound like one extended confrontation, and the paragraph marker alone cannot compel a surface split.

route.title: Renewed building commission and drought explanation
route.deciding_marker_or_seam: Hag.1.7 repeats כה אמר יהוה צבאות and שימו לבבכם; imperatives in 1:8 lead to failed expectation and the יען מה...יען explanation in 1:9, על־כן consequence in 1:10, and the drought catalogue in 1:11, followed by samekh.
route.boundary_rationale: The repeated refrain begins a new commission whose command, disappointed result, causal explanation, and comprehensive drought register resolve together at the marked close after 1:11.
route.counterevidence: The imperative cluster at 1:8 is locally recoverable, and the חָרֵב versus חֹרֶב lexical echo links this unit tightly to the earlier house accusation. The echo is evidence only and does not authorize merging.

route.title: Communal obedience, assurance, stirring, work, and date coda
route.deciding_marker_or_seam: Narrative וַיִּשְׁמַע opens the response at 1:12; 1:13 inserts the messenger assurance, and וַיָּעַר...וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ completes stirring and work at 1:14. Although a pe follows 1:14, 1:15 is a bare date phrase without a fresh word-event formula.
route.boundary_rationale: The date in 1:15 identifies the reported work response and is too syntactically and narratively dependent to surface alone. The real paragraph seam after 1:14 is preserved as an internal coda seam, not promoted to an unsafe isolated date.
route.counterevidence: The WLC-family pe after 1:14 is genuine paragraph evidence, and 1:15 may also orient the following dated oracle. Its attachment is therefore less certain than the book's formula-bounded seams.

route.title: Dated encouragement, former-glory question, and presence reassurance
route.deciding_marker_or_seam: The dated היה דבר־יהוה formula at 2:1 and אמר נא addressee command at 2:2 introduce the questions in 2:3, threefold חזק and work command in 2:4, and covenant-word, Spirit-presence, and אל־תיראו reassurance in 2:5; samekh follows 2:5.
route.boundary_rationale: Question, exhortation, work command, presence ground, and fear-not closure form a coherent encouragement child. The marked closure and fresh כי כה אמר formula at 2:6 support a surface seam while the whole 2:1-9 oracle remains mandatory context.
route.counterevidence: The כי opening at 2:6 grounds or continues the reassurance, and translation of the compressed covenant-word construction in 2:5 remains unresolved.

route.title: Shaking, nations, house glory, and peace promise
route.deciding_marker_or_seam: כי כה אמר יהוה צבאות at 2:6 begins a promise development with repeated shaking language, coordinated realms and nations, the silver-and-gold declaration, and repeated נאם יהוה צבאות closures through glory and peace in 2:9; pe follows 2:9.
route.boundary_rationale: The shaking sequence develops from creation and nations through resources to the house-centered glory-and-peace conclusion. The repeated speech closures and paragraph end bind 2:6-9 while leaving it dependent on the encouragement in 2:1-5.
route.counterevidence: Initial כי links this promise backward to 2:5, and the temporal force of עוד אחת מעט היא and the form and referent of חמדת כל־הגוים are translation hot zones.

route.title: Priestly instruction dialogue and prophetic application
route.deciding_marker_or_seam: The date and היה דבר־יהוה formula at 2:10 lead to שאל נא את־הכהנים תורה at 2:11, the היקדש question and negative answer at 2:12, the היטמא question and positive answer at 2:13, and Haggai's כן...וכן application in 2:14.
route.boundary_rationale: The two asymmetrical contact cases are incomplete without the priests' answers and Haggai's immediate application. The discourse turn ועתה שימו נא לבבכם at 2:15 begins retrospective application and reversal.
rejected_alternatives: Hag.2.10-Hag.2.11 plus separate Hag.2.12 and Hag.2.13
route.counterevidence: No WLC paragraph marker follows 2:14, and the retrospective in 2:15-19 continues the same dated word event's application.

route.title: Retrospective shortfall, foundation-day hinge, and blessing reversal
route.deciding_marker_or_seam: ועתה שימו נא לבבכם at 2:15 introduces retrospective shortage and failed return through 2:17; 2:18 repeats שימו נא לבבכם, identifies the foundation-day threshold, and 2:19 moves from unproduced crops to מן־היום הזה אברך, followed by samekh.
route.boundary_rationale: The first consider movement supplies the negative history against which the repeated refrain and from-today blessing turn function. With no paragraph break at 2:17 and a marked close only after 2:19, the larger reversal unit is safer than surfacing either dependent phase alone.
route.counterevidence: The repeated consider formula and renewed date specification at 2:18 are a real internal child seam. The temporal direction and scope of מן־היום הזה ומעלה remain translation-sensitive.

route.title: Second same-day word to Zerubbabel
route.deciding_marker_or_seam: ויהי דבר־יהוה שנית at 2:20 explicitly opens a second word; אמר אל־זרבבל...לאמר in 2:21 introduces direct address, 2:22 develops the overthrow catalogue, and 2:23 closes with ביום ההוא, repeated נאם יהוה, servant and signet imagery, and the terminal speech formula.
route.boundary_rationale: The explicit second-word formula, single addressee, coordinated overthrow sequence, and repeated closing declarations bind 2:20-23 as the book's final oracle.
route.counterevidence: Shaking language links 2:21-22 to 2:6-7, while servant, signet, and election language creates substantial reception pressure. Those relations do not outweigh the explicit second-word frame.

tested_hard_seams.reason: The saying introduction in 1:1 requires the quoted declaration in 1:2; pe closes the combined unit.
Despite pe after 1:14, the bare date has no new word-event formula and identifies the narrated work response.
Samekh after 2:5 and fresh כי כה אמר at 2:6 support the seam; both require Hag.2.1-9 hydration.
Neither priestly answer is safe or complete apart from Haggai's application in 2:14.
The repeated refrain at 2:18 is preserved as a child seam, but shortage, failed return, foundation threshold, and blessing resolve together before samekh after 2:19.
The explicit second-word frame, direct addressee, overthrow sequence, and repeated speech closure bind the passage.

source_gaps: No authorized passage-pinned primary LXX, DSS, Targum, rabbinic, Second-Temple, ANE, or Persian-period packet was available.
OSHB and UXLC are correlated WLC-family views and cannot be counted as independent textual votes.
The OSHB and UXLC views expose a written/read form at Hag.1.8; this review selects no preferred reading or rendering, and it does not alter the 1:7-11 boundary.
The syntax of Hag.2.5, the temporal force of Hag.2.6, and the form and referent of חמדת כל־הגוים in Hag.2.7 remain unresolved translation questions without present boundary effect.

The temporal direction and scope of מן־היום הזה ומעלה in Hag.2.15 and 2:18 remain unresolved; the repeated discourse frame and reversal architecture support the larger 2:15-19 unit without selecting a rendering.
The servant, signet, and election language in Hag.2.23 remains an identity and reception hot zone; no royal, messianic, historical, or fulfillment identification is authorized.
hold_assessment: No specific unresolved textual or translation question presently changes the proposed surface route. The 1:15 attachment and 2:15-19 internal seam warrant medium confidence and preserved alternatives, not a default human or external-AI hold.
